assets.alt: Particle A projected at 20 m/s at angle θ to the horizontal, and particle B, a distance x away on the same level, projected vertically upwards at 10 m/s.
A at the left fires at 20 m/s at angle θ, with vertical part 20 sin θ; B at distance x fires 10 m/s straight up. The relative velocity v_AB points along AB.
